capital_allocation.note: Cash calculations use only cash generated by the rebalancing plan. Minimum reserve and new-position sizing are adjusted by market regime. Scheduled earnings, macro events and correlation/factor risk can block or reduce new allocations. Existing brokerage cash is not included.

final_portfolio_projection.note: Projection combines modeled V7.1 rebalancing, regime/event/correlation-aware new allocations and cash generated by those modeled trades. Existing brokerage cash is not included.

portfolio_correlation_factor_risk.note: This layer measures hidden diversification risk using historical co-movement and factor proxies. It is diagnostic only and does not automatically liquidate or resize positions.

walk_forward_backtest.engine: V8.0 Historical Replay & Walk-Forward Backtest Engine

methodology.decision_timing: Features use data through prior session; weights execute next session close.
methodology.weighting: Equal base weight across eligible current portfolio names, then strategic exposure multipliers HOLD=1.0, WATCH=0.75, REDUCE=0.50, EXIT=0.0.

equal_weight_control.description: Same current portfolio names, same historical eligibility, same weekly rebalance timing and same trading friction, but without the strategic de-risking overlay.

equal_weight_75_25.label: 75% Equal Weight / 25% Cash
equal_weight_75_25.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

equal_weight_65_35.label: 65% Equal Weight / 35% Cash
equal_weight_65_35.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

volatility_matched_equal_weight.label: Volatility-Matched Equal Weight / Cash
volatility_matched_equal_weight.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

drawdown_matched_equal_weight.label: Drawdown-Matched Equal Weight / Cash
drawdown_matched_equal_weight.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

exposure_attribution_verdict.exposure_proxy_note: Descriptive proxy only; drawdown is nonlinear and this ratio is not a causal decomposition.
exposure_attribution_verdict.methodology_note: Full-sample volatility/drawdown-matched cash allocations use contemporaneous strategy risk. They are hindsight-fit diagnostics, not independent out-of-sample benchmarks.

rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.methodology_note: Every exposure decision is estimated only from the prior 126 sessions and frozen for the next 21 sessions. No future return is used to set that block's benchmark exposure.
rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.cost_model_note: AURORA and the 100% equal-weight source return streams already contain their modeled trading friction. Rolling control returns are scaled from that net control stream, but no additional cost is charged for monthly cash/exposure changes. This is favorable to the benchmark and therefore conservative for AURORA.

bootstrap.methodology_note: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of AURORA and the rolling volatility-matched control. Blocks preserve short-horizon serial dependence better than IID resampling.

regime_stability.trend_rule: RISK_ON when prior-session SPY 63-session return >= 0; otherwise RISK_OFF.
regime_stability.volatility_rule: HIGH_VOL when prior-session SPY 21-session annualized volatility exceeds its 126-session annualized volatility; otherwise LOWER_VOL.

limitations: Current-holdings universe creates survivorship and selection bias.
Bootstrap confidence is conditional on this reconstructed sample and is not an independent live-trading p-value.
Rolling cash/exposure changes in the benchmark do not incur an additional transaction-cost layer.
Full historical news, catalyst, fundamental and broker execution states are not reconstructed.

rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.scope_note: This is out-of-sample exposure attribution for the reconstructable price/risk overlay on the current holdings universe. It does not remove survivorship/selection bias and is not statistical proof of full-system alpha.

validation_verdict.message: Strategic overlay materially reduces drawdown but sacrifices too much return versus the same-universe control. Thresholds should be recalibrated before relying on the overlay.

limitations: Historical news, catalyst and sector snapshots were not archived consistently and are intentionally excluded.

The universe is today's portfolio, creating survivorship and selection bias. The equal-weight control uses the same biased universe so overlay-vs-control is more informative than strategy-vs-SPY for isolating the risk overlay.
This validates the reconstructable strategic price/risk overlay, not the entire live AURORA decision stack.
Taxes are excluded. Trading friction is modeled using the explicit commission and slippage assumptions above.
No parameter optimization is performed inside the test window; sequential folds are fixed-rule out-of-sample replay.
walk_forward_backtest.interpretation: Use this result as evidence about the V7.9 strategic price/risk layer. Do not use it as proof that the full AURORA system is profitable until point-in-time fundamental/news data and broker execution are also validated.

methodology.selection_constraint: Prefer highest CAGR among predefined policies that reduce training max drawdown by at least 15% vs same-universe equal-weight control.
methodology.execution: Prior-session data only; selected policy frozen for the entire next out-of-sample fold.

BALANCED_GENTLE.description: Later exits and smaller de-risking steps.

RETURN_FRIENDLY.description: Keeps more exposure during mixed trends while retaining hard risk exits.

MOMENTUM_FRIENDLY.description: Avoids cutting positions unless long-horizon momentum is decisively broken.

RISK_AWARE_GENTLE.description: Retains meaningful drawdown control but reduces the severity of partial exits.

regime_failure_attribution.next_gate: Keep MOMENTUM_FRIENDLY / historically selected policy behavior in shadow only. Require fresh 20D/60D shadow journal evidence before any live threshold review.

methodology.policy_source: Existing V8.1 predeclared policy family; historical OOS folds reuse only the policy selected from prior training data.
methodology.regime_classification: Same past-only V8.4.5 SPY rules: prior 63-session trend and prior 21-session vs 126-session volatility.
methodology.action_attribution: At weekly simulated execution dates, compare default and historically selected shadow exposure. Evaluate divergence after 20 trading sessions versus SPY.

limitations: Current portfolio universe still creates survivorship and selection bias.
The policy family was designed before this diagnostic but was still evaluated on the same reconstructed history.
Twenty-session event attribution is retrospective and must not be used as a direct live trading trigger.
Historical news, fundamentals, events and broker execution states are not fully reconstructed.

shadow_policy_monitor.promotion_rule: Shadow evidence must mature on fresh forward data before any live policy change is considered.

ibkr_paper_snapshot.reason: Set AURORA_IBKR_ENABLED=true on the IB Gateway VPS to run the paper read-only probe.

ibkr_paper_readiness.engine: V8.3 IBKR Paper Readiness Safety Gate

checks.detail: Connector must run in PAPER mode.
Official IBKR TWS Python API must be installed on the Gateway VPS.
IB Gateway must accept the socket connection.
At least one paper managed account must be returned.
NetLiquidation must be available before execution work.
TotalCashValue must be available before execution work.
AvailableFunds must be available before execution work.
BuyingPower is useful for validation but is not required for the first read-only milestone.
Paper account positions are compared with AURORA CSV. A mismatch is diagnostic at the read-only stage.

methodology.snapshot_frequency: One end-of-day Git snapshot per calendar date.
methodology.modern_signal_sampling: Only action changes are retained to avoid repeated daily recommendations overweighting the sample.
methodology.legacy_opportunity_definition: Entry into daily top 10 with score >= 75. This is a research cohort and is NOT relabeled as BUY.
methodology.legacy_defensive_definition: Explicit dashboard RİSK / ALARM or DİKKAT transition. This is NOT relabeled as REDUCE or EXIT.
methodology.foundation_filter: Modern snapshots requiring LIVE market data; FOUNDATION snapshots are excluded.
methodology.entry_price_basis: Adjusted Yahoo Finance daily close on or before signal date.

claim_guardrails: The V8.0 49.6% hit rate is not a sell-only hit rate; it mixes strategic action changes. Use modern_by_action or modern_defensive_reduce_exit for sell-specific evidence.
Legacy opportunity and portfolio-alert cohorts use older signal semantics and must not be pooled blindly with V7/V8 BUY/REDUCE/EXIT recommendations.
This evidence recovery does not remove survivorship bias from the V8.0 current-portfolio backtest.

methodology.decision_timing: Membership and strategic features are evaluated using the prior trading session; trades execute at the next session close.
methodology.ranking: V7.9 strategic composite with historical catalyst and sector components held neutral at 50.
methodology.membership: Latest point-in-time membership snapshot effective on or before the decision date.

limitations: Yahoo Finance may have incomplete price history for delisted, renamed or acquired securities. Coverage is reported at every rebalance and remains a residual survivorship/data-availability risk.
Historical fundamentals, analyst revisions, news, catalysts and sector-state snapshots are not reconstructed; the test validates the reconstructable strategic price/risk ranking only.
The external membership source is pinned to a fixed Git commit and the test ends before that commit date for reproducibility.
Forward-filled prices are used only for valuation of existing positions when a daily quote disappears; new purchases require an exact execution-date quote.
